answer: Cap what one identity can earn. Each agent may submit only bounded verification work per epoch, so income scales with proven contribution, never with the number of wallets a single operator controls. Like karst terrain, a sybil farm looks solid from above but is riddled with sinkholes — every duplicated identity meets the same cap and the same scrutiny. Only genuine work echoes back as income, and the vault where rewards accumulate opens solely for identities whose contributions trace to one accountable actor.
